sources.primary_title: LEAP 2026 sees launch of new technologies for HR and financial operations
sources.verified_angle_summary: At LEAP 2026, Saudi technology company Jisr announced the launch of its next-generation platform designed to unify human resources and financial operations. The expanded system connects employee management, payroll, payments, expenses, and accounting processes into a single ecosystem, moving away from fragmented digital systems. Jisr, which currently serves over 5,000 organizations and processes more than SAR 10 billion in payroll, aims to bridge the gap between HR and finance departments. The platform upgrade includes modernizing 70% of its technology workloads to double transaction capacity without increasing costs, while ensuring compliance with Saudi regulations such as GOSI and the Wage Protection System. This angle is distinct as it focuses on a specific enterprise SaaS launch and its operational impact, rather than general event overviews.
sources.verified_key_facts: Jisr launched a next-generation HR and finance platform at LEAP 2026; The platform integrates employee operations, payroll, payments, expenses, and accounting; Jisr currently serves over 5,000 HR and finance teams and supports more than 800,000 employees; The value of payroll processed through the platform exceeds SAR 10 billion; Jisr modernized approximately 70% of its technology workloads to double transaction capacity; The platform complies with Saudi Labor Law, GOSI, Wage Protection System, and Saudization requirements; The company experienced over 100% annual growth following a $30 million Series A funding round led by Merak Capital in 2023.
